HAPPY NEW MONTH! Welcome to November 2026 — SUPERNATURAL PROVISION.

“But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.” — Philippians 4:19 (KJV)

As we begin this month, let us trust God’s care, seek His wisdom and walk faithfully in His Word.

With love and prayers,
Apostle (Dr) Anchord Taiwo, Senior Pastor
Christ’s Reformation House International Inc.

Begin this week with your heart resting in the Shepherd’s care. Bring your needs to God in prayer and follow His leading in the practical steps before you.

November 2026 • Supernatural Provision

Let God’s kingdom shape your priorities today. Make room for the Word, prayer, honest work and generosity.

ONE WEEK INTO NOVEMBER — KEEP WALKING IN FAITH
Our theme remains SUPERNATURAL PROVISION.

As this first week closes, remember these three Bible truths:
• Trust God’s supply — Philippians 4:19.
• Rest in the Shepherd’s care — Psalm 23:1.
• Seek His kingdom first — Matthew 6:33.

Share these November banners with someone who needs encouragement, and continue reading the Word with us.

Apostle (Dr) Anchord Taiwo
Christ’s Reformation House International Inc.
